counter_hypotheses.claim: ANIMO 4.0 guide can be treated as exact revision-53 theory.
Absence of a dry continuation state in this guide proves such physics is impossible.
Adsorbed NH4 in the nitrogen cycle can be reused directly as the residual surface owner.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Guide places adsorption in soil solid-phase context; SQ04 source audit binds NH4 sorption to soil layers.

counter_hypotheses.claim: CONHTOP can serve as the continuation owner because it is a top-layer NH4 state.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Guide identifies CONHTOP as the virtual top layer used for additions, distinct from compartment concentrations.

counter_hypotheses.claim: FRVO is a generic dry-surface NH4 volatilization law.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Guide ties FRVO to material-addition events and the NH4 fraction of the addition.

counter_hypotheses.claim: The supplied guide resolves the rewetting receiver or kinetics.
The broader ANIMO literature contains no such process law.
counter_hypotheses.basis: The guide points to more comprehensive theory sources not qualified in SQ05.

residual_uncertainty: Comprehensive ANIMO theory referenced by the guide may contain additional relevant process semantics.
